name: BetterPause
description: An overhaul and enhancement for the Geometry Dash pause menu, featuring custom pause styles and built-in Pause Zoom.

issues.info: Report any issues you have on GitHub issues.

type-pause.name: Select Pause
type-pause.description:
Choose the type of pause style you want: 
1. BetterPause 
2. ClassicPause 
3. SimplePause 
0. DisablePause (You could just disable the mod, but just in case).

enable-pause-zoom.name: Enable Pause Zoom
enable-pause-zoom.description: Allows you to zoom in/out with the mouse wheel and pan with WASD or mouse drag while in the pause menu.

pause-zoom-sensitivity.name: Zoom Sensitivity
pause-zoom-sensitivity.description: Adjusts how quickly the camera zooms in and out with the mouse wheel.

pause-zoom-pan-speed.name: Pan Speed
pause-zoom-pan-speed.description: Adjusts the panning speed with WASD and arrow keys. Hold Shift to move 2.5x faster.

enable-player-theme.name: Player Theme Colors
enable-player-theme.description: Sync pause menu progress bar and minimap border with your player icon colors.

enable-pause-animations.name: Smooth Pause Animations
enable-pause-animations.description: Enable smooth pop-in, ambient idle breathing, and exit animations for pause menu elements.

pause-music-track.name: Pause Music Track
pause-music-track.description:
Select the background music to play while paused:
0: Disabled
1: Stay Inside Me (Iconic Chill)
2: The Vault (secretLoop)
3: Chamber of Time (secretLoop02)
4: The Shop (shop)
5: Secret Shop (secretShop)

pause-music-volume.name: Pause Music Volume
pause-music-volume.description: Volume level for the pause background music.

enable-unpause-countdown.name: Unpause Countdown
enable-unpause-countdown.description: Shows a 3.. 2.. 1.. GO countdown when resuming to prepare your reaction before physics resume. Press Space or Esc to skip instantly.

enable-progress-milestones.name: Progress Bar Milestones
enable-progress-milestones.description: Shows markers on the progress bar for your Session Best and coin locations.

enable-death-marker.name: Last Death Marker
enable-death-marker.description: Shows where you died on your last attempt on the progress bar and in the level while paused.

level-editor-hack.name: Level Editor Hack
level-editor-hack.description: I couldn't adapt the level edit recognition of the mods menus, sorry :(

show-comment-button.name: Show Comment button
show-comment-button.description: Displays the level comments button, in general, in the level information and comments button.

amount-scroll-button.name: Scroll Amount Button
amount-scroll-button.description: How much space the button list moves up and down with the up and down buttons.

Quick-Settings-Select.name: Quick Settings Select
Quick-Settings-Select.description: Select which quick settings are available in the pause menu.

disable-creator-label.name: Disable Level Author and Rating Label
disable-creator-label.description: Disable Level Author and Rating Label.

tolerance-in-buttons-list.name: Tolerance in Buttons List
tolerance-in-buttons-list.description: Being able to turn off buttons while scrolling through a list, with a set distance from the scroll button.

enabled-info-button.name: Enabled Info Button
enabled-info-button.description: Enabled Info Level. (Recommend using "Level Info in Pause Menu")

enabled-coins-viewer.name: Enabled Coins Viewer
enabled-coins-viewer.description: Enabled Coins Viewer. (Recommend using "Coins in the Pause Menu")

original-comment-button-sprite.name: Original Comment Button Sprite
original-comment-button-sprite.description: Change Comment Button Sprite to Original

disable-rating-plus-label.name: Disable Rating Label
disable-rating-plus-label.description: Disable Rating Label In Creator Label.

disable-icon-rating-plus-label.name: Disable Icon Rating Label
disable-icon-rating-plus-label.description: Disable Icon Rating Label In Creator Label.
